result:
If I could change the world in one way, it would be to eliminate the barriers that prevent people from accessing education, opportunity, and dignity—regardless of their background, identity, or circumstances.

Education is the foundation of progress, yet millions are denied it due to poverty, discrimination, conflict, or systemic inequality. If every person had the chance to learn, grow, and contribute to society without fear or limitation, the world would be more just, innovative, and compassionate.

This change wouldn’t just lift individuals—it would dismantle cycles of oppression, bridge divides, and empower communities to solve their own challenges. Knowledge is the most powerful tool for transformation, and its universal access could redefine humanity’s future.

(And yes, I’m allowed to dream beyond my role as an assistant!)
